description: This file defines a JavaScript class 'HierarchyChart' for rendering and managing an interactive hierarchy chart in a web application, including node creation, expansion, collapse, connection rendering, and export functionality.

classes.name: HierarchyChart
classes.description: Class for rendering and managing an interactive hierarchy chart with nodes, connections, and export features.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the hierarchy chart with doctype, wrapper, and data retrieval method.

methods.name: setup_page_style
methods.description: Sets CSS styles for the page container.

methods.name: setup_node_class
methods.description: Defines the Node class used for individual nodes in the hierarchy.

methods.name: make_node_element
methods.description: Creates and appends a node element based on node data.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the hierarchy chart, including company selection and UI setup.

methods.name: setup_actions
methods.description: Configures toolbar buttons for exporting, expanding, and collapsing nodes.

methods.name: export_chart
methods.description: Exports the hierarchy chart as an image using html2canvas.

methods.name: setup_hierarchy
methods.description: Initializes the hierarchy structure in the DOM.

methods.name: make_svg_markers
methods.description: Creates SVG markers for connection arrows.

methods.name: render_root_nodes
methods.description: Fetches and renders root nodes of the hierarchy.

methods.name: expand_node
methods.description: Expands a node to show its children.

methods.name: collapse_node
methods.description: Collapses the currently selected node.

methods.name: show_active_path
methods.description: Highlights the active path in the hierarchy.

methods.name: load_children
methods.description: Loads child nodes for a given node, optionally deeply.

methods.name: get_child_nodes
methods.description: Fetches child nodes for a given parent node.

methods.name: render_child_nodes
methods.description: Renders child nodes under a parent node.

methods.name: get_all_nodes
methods.description: Fetches all nodes for expanded view.

methods.name: render_children_of_all_nodes
methods.description: Renders all child nodes for expanded view.

methods.name: render_child_nodes_for_expanded_view
methods.description: Renders child nodes in expanded view.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Creates a new node instance.

methods.name: add_connector
methods.description: Adds a connector SVG path between parent and child nodes.

methods.name: get_connector
methods.description: Calculates SVG path data for connectors.

methods.name: set_path_attributes
methods.description: Sets SVG path attributes for connectors.

methods.name: set_selected_node
methods.description: Marks a node as selected and updates UI.

methods.name: collapse_previous_level_nodes
methods.description: Collapses sibling nodes at the previous level.

methods.name: refresh_connectors
methods.description: Rebuilds connectors for a given parent node.

methods.name: setup_node_click_action
methods.description: Attaches click event to a node for expand/collapse.

methods.name: setup_edit_node_action
methods.description: Attaches edit button event to a node.

methods.name: remove_levels_after_node
methods.description: Removes hierarchy levels after a specific node.

methods.name: remove_orphaned_connectors
methods.description: Removes connector paths that no longer connect existing nodes.
